description: This Java class defines a thread, Hl7InArchivesMigrateThread, responsible for migrating HL7 archives from database tables to the filesystem within the OpenMRS system. It manages the migration process, tracks progress, handles errors, and ensures proper session management.

classes.name: Hl7InArchivesMigrateThread
classes.description: A thread class that manages the migration of HL7 archives from the database to the filesystem, with progress tracking, error handling, and session management.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method that performs the migration loop while the thread is active and the status is RUNNING, handling exceptions and updating the transfer status.

methods.name: setProgressStatusMap
methods.description: Static method to set the progress status map tracking migration progress.

methods.name: setDaysKept
methods.description: Static method to set the number of days' worth of data to keep during migration.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Static method to activate or deactivate the thread.

methods.name: setTransferStatus
methods.description: Static method to update the current transfer status.

methods.name: stopMigration
methods.description: Static method to set the transfer status to STOPPED and deactivate the thread, halting migration.

methods.name: getTransferStatus
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current transfer status.

methods.name: getNumberTransferred
methods.description: Static method to get the number of items transferred so far.

methods.name: getNumberOfFailedTransfers
methods.description: Static method to get the number of failed transfer attempts.

methods.name: getUserContext
methods.description: Method to retrieve the user context associated with the thread.
